summary: liveranov demonstrates a high-damage Dauntless team setup against Area Boss 3 (Abyssal Emissary) in the Crisis Rally event. The featured team of Nastjenka, Kurvida, Guinavivre, Tharivol, and Astaion reaches over 16.4 billion total damage. Detailed hero gear stats and automatic skill timing options are displayed following the combat run.
